Your family will love the spaciousness of this 1723-SF brick home on 111.9 beautiful acres of farm land. Features include 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a gracious dining room with carpeting, an impressive family room with a fireplace, a charming kitchen with a dishwasher, a garbage disposal, an electric range, double sinks, custom cabinets, and a refrigerator. This property is currently AG exempt and outside of the city limits. Hunting is permitted.  Live oak trees, a stock tank, and a barn complete the property.   This wonderful piece of land was originally inhabited by the early Wendish settlers, and it can be yours today!
